scenarios.label: 1 intermittent API, no database (360 req/day, 90 spaced windows)

gregale_free.note: Within 20 GB-RAM-h Free allowance; pauses ~1-2 s after each request.

gregale_hobby.note: Includes up to 5 apps, 200 GB-RAM-h, and 1 Postgres (1 GiB, 7d PITR).

render_free.note: Spins down after 15 min idle (~1 min cold start); 750 free h/mo.

render_paid.note: Render Starter 512 MB ($7/service) + Basic 256 MB Postgres ($6 if used).

railway_hobby_always_on.note: Hobby $5 minimum; assumed small always-on Postgres ($3.50/mo) when needed.

railway_hobby_serverless.note: Serverless sleep (5-10 min idle threshold; 300 s used). Never triggers at 30 s spacing.

fly_auto_stop.note: Auto-stop Machines (300 s idle threshold) + 1 GB stopped rootfs + Dev Postgres ($4 if used).

fly_always_on.note: Always-on shared-cpu-1x Machines + Developer Postgres ($4 if used).

cloud_run_compute_only.note: Tier 1 request-based billing with permanent monthly free tier.

heroku_paid.note: Basic 512 MB dynos ($7/app) + Essential-0 Postgres ($5 if used).
